limitations.note: The agent correctly clocked the counter but removed the existing `ready_b` guard, so the first accepted input of a group overwrites `data_out` even when the reference would add it to the current value.

The scoreboard assumed every group starts a fresh sum and checked `data_out` only when a result was pending, so it validated the rewrite rather than checking the original `ready_b`-dependent update behavior.
